body.message:
Good morning,

I hope you are doing well.

We would like to kindly inform you that the property owner has requested a brief viewing of the apartment tomorrow.

Would it be possible for you to accommodate the viewing? If so, could you please let us know what time would be most convenient for you, so we can coordinate the viewing with the owner accordingly?

The viewing will be brief, and we truly appreciate your kind cooperation and understanding.

Thank you in advance.
